events.title: Demo Update 3
events.summary: If you haven't already please leave me a Steam review, it really helps me a lot!Demo Update 3 is here and it brings a bunch of polishing changes, minor balance changes and a highly requested ability to zoom out. Here's the full changelog:ZoomYou can now zoom out. The game uses a fixed zoom out scale because I want to preserve the pixel perfect look of the game as much as I can. events.title: Demo Update 1
events.summary: First major demo updated has landed!I'm thrilled that so many of you have enjoyed Fireworks Incremental and I'm also very thankful for the feedback you've sent.The game is in a pretty good state but it could also use some balancing changes as well as quality of life improvements and that's my goal for this update - to make the game feel and play better.Here's a full list of changes that I've made over the last week since releasing the demo:Balance and pacingUnlocking Prestige Hall is now faster

events.title: Fireworks Incremental demo is here!
events.summary: Fireworks Incremental demo is here!The Bad Wizard has arrived and he put a Magical Dome over the land. Use fireworks to destroy it and free everybody from the Bad Wizard's grip.Demo contains about 45-60 minutes of gameplay and will take you through all of the game's systems and you'll be able to experience what the full game will be like.Can't wait to hear what you think. If you have any feedback, let me know in the comments, Steam discussions or you can use this form here: https://docs.google.c
